description: This file defines classes, enums, and structures related to the front panel control in a device, including blinking indicators, brightness settings, and observer management.

classes.name: BlinkInfo
classes.description: Represents blinking information associated with a front panel.

classes.name: CFrontPanel
classes.description: Manages front panel operations such as LED control, brightness, and observer notifications.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of CFrontPanel.

methods.name: addEventObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer for front panel events.

methods.name: removeEventObserver
methods.description: Removes an observer for front panel events.

methods.name: setBrightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness level of the front panel.

methods.name: powerOffLed
methods.description: Turns off a specific LED indicator.

methods.name: powerOnLed
methods.description: Turns on a specific LED indicator.

methods.name: getPreferences
methods.description: Retrieves current preferences as a JSON object.

methods.name: setPreferences
methods.description: Sets preferences from a JSON object.

methods.name: setLED
methods.description: Sets LED state based on blink info.

methods.name: setBlink
methods.description: Sets blinking pattern based on blink info.

methods.name: is24HourClock
methods.description: Checks if 24-hour clock mode is enabled.
